Information

The corrosion of a steam and 
 condensate line sometimes causes a steam leakage at the joints of pipings, 
 branch pipings and so on with the thin wall thicknesses. Sufficient 
 countermeasures against the corrosion should be taken because the steam 
 leakage leads to a great energy loss.
